## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: night and inclement weather driving
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The whole manual carries an old content-currency date (stated in part A), so any rule here may have changed since; the freshness debt in part A covers every fact in this section.
The skid and headlight illustrations were not used; only the step text beside them was taught, including the worked rear-slides-left example [A03].
The threshold-braking steps on snow and ice are printed without saying whether the car has antilock brakes, so they are taught exactly as printed, and the separate antilock rule of constant firm pressure is taught on its own [A05].
The chapter's sample questions are review aids, and their answers sit in the back of the manual outside the selected pages, so no sample answer is taught as a fact [A05].
The hail advice to shelter under an overpass or bridge is taught as the manual prints it and is attributed to the manual in the fact text.
The flood-safety web link printed in the chapter was not opened or checked, and the flood slogan is taught only as a memory phrase.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.
